title: Beltworks — Conveyor Factory Workbench
description: Draw conveyor belts, feed smelters and assemblers, watch throughput climb, then ship contracts and export the blueprint.
concept: Beltworks is a tile factory you build by dragging. Belts auto-orient along the path you draw, mines push ore into whatever they face, smelters turn two ore into a plate, assemblers fuse a copper and an iron plate into a circuit, splitters round-robin their output and shipping bays count everything that arrives. A live stats panel tracks items per minute per product, three contracts give you production targets, and any factory you build can be shared as a URL, downloaded as JSON or saved as a PNG of the floor.
features: Drag-to-draw belts that auto-orient around corners, plus rotate and erase tools
Six machine types with a real recipe chain: ore to plates to circuits
Discrete belt simulation with per-tile item handoff, machine buffers and craft timers
Live throughput stats: shipped per item, items/min over a rolling window, items in transit
Three shipping contracts with progress bars and persisted completion times
Four built-in blueprints, variable sim speed from 0.25x to 3x
Export: share-URL blueprint codec, JSON download, JSON import and PNG of the factory floor
Autosaves the factory and finished contracts to localStorage

interaction.mouse: Hover highlights the target tile; drag with the Belt tool to paint an auto-oriented belt path.
interaction.click: Place the selected tool, rotate an existing tile with Rotate, remove it with Erase.
interaction.touch: Tap tools in the bottom palette, drag on the floor to lay belts, open the stats sheet with the Panel button.
interaction.keyboard: 1-9 select tools, R turns the placement facing, Space runs or pauses, Backspace jumps to the eraser.
